_about: Public-domain James De Normandie, Unitarian minister at Portsmouth, New Hampshire, and the First Church in Roxbury, for the Word Hoard: The Lord Reigneth (on the assassination of Lincoln) and memorial sketches of Harriet Ryan Albee and Francis Bickford Hornbrooke. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 126 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
